crossRefs.note: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man…
I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor…
The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children…
About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
translations.bsb: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
translations.kjv: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
translations.asv: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
